<!--
  THE SPINE. This file decides which sections appear and in what order.
  Everything else -- the content of a section AND its style -- lives in that
  section's own file under sections/.

  Reorder the list below to reorder the CV. Comment out a name to drop that
  section. Add a name to add one (create sections/<name>.yml first).
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/cv-helpers.R")
```

```{r}

cv_section("policy-publications")

cv_section("presentations")

cv_section("skills")

cv_raw("#pagebreak()\n")

cv_section("references")

```
